explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about the library's own objects, `quotientHomogeneousBasis` and `hankelIdeal` (the quotient of `Source R n` by the Hankel ideal of the rational normal curve). Mathlib has no rational normal curve, no Hankel ideal and no homogeneous basis of such a quotient. So the content of the statement lies in the library's own definitions. The proof uses only library lemmas (`quotientCoefficientEmbedding_injective`, `rncMap_monomial`, `fiberNormalExponent_degree`) plus generic glue (`monomial_mul_monomial`, `map_mul`, `omega`), and none of these carries the result. I did not search Mathlib's sources, because no Mathlib declaration can mention these library definitions.
